passage.label: NOTICE — Maple Street Library
passage.text:
Beginning June 1, the Maple Street Library will extend its weekday hours. The library will now open at 8:00 A.M. and close at 9:00 P.M., Monday through Friday. Weekend hours will remain the same (10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.).

In addition, a new self-checkout machine has been installed near the main entrance. Visitors may use it to borrow books without waiting in line. Please note that DVDs and magazines must still be checked out at the front desk.

For more information, please call 555-0188.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To describe new services and hours
questions.exp: 開館時間の延長と、新しい貸出機の設置を知らせている。

questions.q: What is indicated about weekend hours?
questions.exp: Weekend hours will remain the same と書かれている。remain the same = 変わらない。

questions.q: What can NOT be borrowed using the self-checkout machine?
questions.exp: DVDs and magazines must still be checked out at the front desk とあるので、雑誌はセルフ貸出機では借りられない。

passage.label: From: Linda Cho / To: Marcus Reed / Date: March 12 / Subject: Training Session
passage.text:
Dear Marcus,

Thank you for agreeing to lead the customer service training session on April 3. As we discussed, about twenty new employees will attend. The session will take place in Room 204, starting at 9:30 A.M. and ending around noon.

Could you please send me the presentation slides by March 28? I'd like to print copies for the participants. Also, let me know if you need any equipment, such as a microphone or extra chairs.

Best regards,
Linda Cho
Training Coordinator

questions.q: Why did Ms. Cho write the e-mail?
choices: To thank Mr. Reed for a past event
To request materials and confirm details
questions.exp: 研修の詳細を確認し、スライドの送付を依頼している(send me the presentation slides)。

questions.q: What is Mr. Reed asked to do by March 28?
questions.exp: Could you please send me the presentation slides by March 28? とある。印刷するのは Cho さん。

questions.q: What is suggested about the training session?
choices: It is for new staff members.
questions.exp: about twenty new employees will attend とあるので、新入社員向けの研修。9:30 から正午ごろまでなので、終日ではない。

passage.label: Local Business News
passage.text:
Bella's Bakery to Open Second Location

Bella's Bakery, a family-owned business in Dover since 2012, announced yesterday that it will open a second shop in Springfield next month. Owner Bella Morris said the decision came after years of requests from customers who live outside Dover.

"We have always wanted to bring our bread to more people," Ms. Morris said. The new shop will employ ten workers, and the bakery plans to hold a grand opening event with free samples on its first Saturday. Ms. Morris added that all of the bakery's recipes will remain unchanged.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.exp: 2 号店の開業を伝える記事なので、事業の拡大(expansion)。

questions.q: According to the article, why did Ms. Morris decide to open a new shop?
choices: The rent in Dover is too high.
questions.exp: Dover の外に住む客から何年も要望があったため(requests from customers)。

questions.q: What is mentioned about the grand opening?
choices: It will be held in Dover.
It will last for a week.
questions.exp: オープンの最初の土曜日に、無料の試食(free samples)を出す予定と書かれている。

passage.text:
Spring Sale! March 1 – March 15

Free delivery on orders over $100. Orders under $100 incur a $10 shipping fee.

passage.label: E-MAIL — From: Amy Torres / To: Sunrise Office Supplies / Date: March 10
passage.text:
Hello,

I would like to order 20 packs of printer paper and two office chairs ($59 each). Please send them to our office at 18 Oak Road. I will be paying by credit card.

Also, could you tell me when I can expect the delivery?

Thank you,
Amy Torres

questions.q: What is indicated about the sale?
questions.exp: 広告に March 1 – March 15 と期間が書かれている。

questions.q: How much will Ms. Torres pay for the items (not including shipping)?
Will Ms. Torres have to pay a shipping fee?
choices: Yes, because she ordered after the sale ended.
Yes, because the order is under $100.
No, because her order is over $100.
No, because she is a regular customer.
questions.exp: 注文合計は $208 で $100 を超えるので、送料は無料(Free delivery on orders over $100)。2 つの文章の情報を合わせて解く問題。
